Chapter 873: Chapter 14: You Are All Surrounded By Me (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 873: Chapter 14: You Are All Surrounded by Me (Please Subscribe)_2

The only explanation is that the Galaxy Master was not affected by the Two-dimensional World.

This is consistent with Xueyu surviving and leaving the Two-dimensional World.

…

Numerous clues all point to one possibility.

That is, the human Xueyu, who massacred in the Two-dimensional World, is actually the Galaxy Master.

If it were just one similar clue, it might have been a coincidence, but with all clues being so similar, even without concrete evidence, the Supreme Beings of the Star Alliance are mostly convinced.

“Um?”

“And then?”

Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, said indifferently.

When Lin Yuan entered the battlefield and revealed some of his power,

Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, foresaw that the identity of human Xueyu might be exposed.

But so what?

If it’s exposed, then it’s exposed.

What can the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, who died at the hands of human Xueyu in the Two-dimensional World, do?

“Very good.”

The Supreme Being of the Star Alliance was silent for a while, feeling a strong shock in his heart.

Even when he saw human Xueyu crushing the Four Divine Kings in the Two-dimensional World initially, he wasn’t much shocked, especially after speculating that this human Xueyu might possess treasures granted by the Human Civilization Alliance.

But when human Xueyu overlapped with the Galaxy Master, this Supreme Being of the Star Alliance became somewhat restless.

Monster.

The monstrous degree of the Galaxy Master exceeded the expectations of all Supreme Beings.

“Human Xueyu, is the Galaxy Master?”

“How is that possible? Wasn’t the Galaxy Master a Level Ten at that time?”

“A Level Ten can sweep a Level Eleven Perfect?”

The many Supreme Beings, quick in their thoughts, also associated the Galaxy Master with human Xueyu.

Sweeping a Level Eleven Perfect wouldn’t surprise the Supreme Beings, but a Level Ten sweeping a Level Eleven Perfect, even in an environment like the Two-dimensional World, is utterly ridiculous.

Even the Robber Clan couldn’t possibly do it, right?

Indeed, the Robber Clan is known to be invincible among their peers, but fighting across levels? From Level One to Twelve, perhaps below Level Six, it’s possible to fight across levels as the gaps are not large.

But the higher the level, the more difficult it becomes to fight across levels. A Level Ten fighting across to a Level Eleven Perfect?

…

The fact that human Xueyu is the Galaxy Master spread among the Supreme Beings, and soon those strongest Level Eleven beings below them also learned about it.

Especially inside the massive battlefield, many Alien Strong Ones need to treat the Galaxy Master as their opponent, the more they know about him the more confident they are.

“The Galaxy Master is that human Xueyu?”

“Really?”

“The Supreme Being told me personally, what do you think?”

…

The Level Eleven elites of the major peak powers could hardly believe it, many of whom had experienced the journey to the Two-dimensional World and still linger under the shadow of human Xueyu.

Now they are told that the human Xueyu back then was merely Level Ten, and just a few hundred years old?

…

“Galaxy Master?”

Inside the war base of the Star Alliance, the Four Divine Kings sat cross-legged, their faces falling into silence once again.

The impact that human Xueyu initially had on them was already great, but now, knowing the true identity of human Xueyu, the Four Divine Kings found themselves momentarily blank.

…

War base of the Human Civilization Alliance.

Xuanyuan You and a group of Level Eleven evolutionists were also having a lively discussion.

“The Galaxy Master is Level Eleven?”

“So that’s why the Galaxy Master became the dominator of this war.”

“With such strength at Level Ten, I feel I’ve wasted millions of years.”

The Level Eleven evolutionists excitedly discussed, compared to other Alien Strong Ones, the evolutionists of Human Civilization felt not just shock, but also a sense of pride upon learning that human Xueyu is the Galaxy Master.

After all, this is a peerless genius from their Human Civilization.

Although human Xueyu is originally a human evolver, human Xueyu and the Galaxy Master are not the same thing at all.

Human Xueyu, no matter how strong, is still within reason, as it’s unknown how many years human Xueyu practiced.

But the Galaxy Master? The growth trajectory of the Galaxy Master is no secret, easily traceable with a bit of investigation.

The overlap of the two creates a shock effect far surpassing any individual one.

“Galaxy Master, is it the human Xueyu?”

In the corner, Nalan was somewhat stunned, only now remembering how he had repeatedly invited Lin Yuan to meet the human Xueyu in the Two-dimensional World, but it had never been realized.

Now it seems,

the human Xueyu is the Galaxy Master.

Why bother meeting, then not meeting.

“Alright.”

“Whether the Galaxy Master is the human Xueyu or not, we cannot afford to lose in the upcoming war.”

Xuanyuan You was equally shocked, but his face showed no expression; instead, he calmly spoke.

“No wonder the Supreme Being said that the Galaxy Master has the most hope of stepping into Level Twelve. With such capability at Level Ten, the foundation is indeed a great deal stronger than mine.”

Xuanyuan You thought to himself.

…

Time slowly passed.

The fact that the human Xueyu was the Galaxy Master stirred quite a ripple among the Level Eleven circles but was soon suppressed by the looming large-scale war.

The core area of the mega-sized battlefield.

The twelve pinnacle clan forces began to converge continuously at the center of the battlefield.

One by one, the Level Eleven powerhouses stood in the void, their terrifying aura permeating and the power of Level Twelve supreme weapons expanding and colliding.

“Human.”

Several Insect Race Hives hovered in midair, and a massive army of Insect Race Warriors surged out.

During the massive war, various pinnacle clan forces clashed in turn; the Human Civilization Alliance and the Insect Race Alliance were opponents.

Moreover, the other ten pinnacle clans were also engaged in slaughter. In the vast center of the battlefield, the fluctuations of space-time boiled, and frightful aura burst forth unchecked.

“Watch out for soul attacks.”

Xuanyuan You took the lead and charged towards the largest Hive.

Buzzing.

Space twisted, and terrifying soul attacks descended, numerous Level Eleven Perfect Insect Race Warriors launching attacks simultaneously.

Although the Insect Race Hive was not adept at direct combat, it did not mean it lacked any self-preservation abilities. The soul attacks from the Insect Race Hive were unique among the eleven pinnacle clan forces.

Insect Race Hives needed to control a large number of Insect Race Warriors simultaneously, which required a vast amount of mental will. The higher the mental will, the stronger the mastery in soul aspects.

“Not good.”

Xuanyuan You only felt his vision blur before he recovered, a golden gem subtly appearing on his forehead to suppress the soul and resist any attacks.

“Unexpectedly, you Insect Race’s Queen brought that treasure along.”

Xuanyuan You’s face became solemn, staring directly at the distant huge Insect Race Hive, waves of illusory fluctuations spreading from the Hive center to all directions, impacting all Level Eleven powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Nightmare Realm.”

Xuanyuan You stared at the tiny palace-shaped weapon atop the huge Insect Race Hive.

The Nightmare Realm was the Insect Race’s Clan Suppression Weapon, extremely potent in area soul attacks. This weapon had troubled the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being of human civilization many times.

…

On another side of the battlefield.

A terrifying figure casually exerted force.

Around him, seven to eight figures were struggling hard, each of these figures emitting an aura not inferior to Xuanyuan You’s, yet they were being overpowered by the onslaught of a single powerful being and were at a disadvantage.

“Human civilization is struggling… Where did that Galaxy Master go?”

This terrifying figure was the strongest Level Eleven of the Robber Clan, his gaze glancing at the battlefield between humans and the Insect Race.

The matter of the Galaxy Master and human Xueyu also piqued his curiosity. He had seen the battle images from the Two-dimensional World, and the power of the human Xueyu had even put some pressure on him.

…

“The Insect Race actually brought the Nightmare Realm.”

“Human civilization is in danger. Without a same-level Clan Suppression Weapon, defeat might be inevitable.”

“Hehe, where is the Galaxy Master then? Is he too scared to even appear?”

Other pinnacle clan forces engaged in battle also observed, noting the dire situation human civilization was falling into.

…

“Soul Annihilation!”

In the battlefield between the Insect Race and human civilization, the largest Insect Race Hive was fully activating the Clan Suppression Weapon, Nightmare Realm.

The void power of the Nightmare began sweeping, many human civilization’s evolvers felt their consciousness drift towards unconsciousness, faces showing signs of despair.

Just then.

A diminutive young man suddenly arrived at the center of the battlefield, raising his right foot and gently stomping down, space-time faintly turning into a swirling millstone, crushing numerous powerful Insect Race Warriors.

The largest Insect Race Hive was forced to retreat a great distance, the Nightmare Realm atop it spinning rapidly.

The young man looked around, his gaze crossing the battlefield between the Insect Race and human civilization, looking towards other pinnacle clan forces engaged in battle, a smile appearing on his face.

“You are all surrounded by me!”
